name: Douro Valley & Porto
about: Porto stays mild year-round; the inland valley gets genuinely scorching in summer.
overview: The terraced valley where Port wine is grown, and the coastal city where it's aged and shipped from — the wine lodges of Vila Nova de Gaia sit right across the river from Porto's old town, with river cruises linking the two.
costOverview: Porto itself is one of Western Europe's better values — coffee and a port wine cellar tour both cost a fraction of Lisbon prices — though a proper Douro Valley vineyard estate day trip is a real splurge many visitors build in.
